opener_concept: Taxi fare shown as a function machine: £3 to get in plus £2 per mile. A 4-mile trip is £3 + £2×4 = £11 by pure common sense; a 6-mile trip is £15. Each time the student multiplies the miles by 2 then adds 3, which IS substituting into C = 3 + 2m. The reveal names that as substitution.
